name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
August 14, 2007
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 600 Eucalyptus Avenue, Vista, CA
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Reverend Jeff Lee, Chaplain for Elizabeth Hospice
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Proclamation declaring August 15, 2007, "Sergeant Adam Pfeil Day" in the City of Vista for his military contributions to the United States of America. (CC)
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
Recommended Action:
Receive the check register.
C2.
Ordinances on Agenda (CC)
Recommended Action:
Waive reading of ordinances on the agenda.
C3.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/BSD)
Recommended Action:
Approve the following Minutes:
June 20, 2007, Special joint Dinner Meeting (CC)
June 26, 2007, Regular Meeting (CC/CDC/BSD)
C4.
Second Reading of Ordinances (CC)
Recommended Action:
Adopt the following Ordinances:
1.
City Council Ordinance No. 2007-11, entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Vista, California, Approving a Zone Change from Commercial with a Qualified Development Overlay (C-1-Q) and Multi Residential with a Qualified Development Overlay (RM-87-Q) to Specific Implementation (SPI) and Replacing Specific Plan No. 28 with a New Specific Plan on 15.9 Acres at 1155 Foothill Drive";
2.
City Council Ordinance No. 2007-12, entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Vista, California, Amending Chapters 16.56, 16.57, 18.02, 18.54, and 19.12 of the Vista Development Code Relating to Street Standards";
3.
City Council Ordinance No. 2007-13, entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Vista, California, Amending Chapter 18.31 of the Vista Development Code Relating to Second Unit Driveway Requirements"; and
4.
City Council Ordinance No. 2007-14, entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Vista, California, Amending Chapter 16.40 of the Vista Municipal Code Uniform Fire Code Relating to Fire Department Access."
C5.
Treasurer's Cash Report for Month Ending April 30, 2007 (CC)
Recommended Action:
Receive the report.
C6.
Treasurer's Cash Report for Month Ending May 31, 2007 (CC)
Recommended Action:
Receive the report.
C7.
Travel and Training Authorization and Expense Reporting Policy (CC)
Recommended Action:
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2007- , establishing the per diem and mileage allowances for certain expenses incurred on City business.
C8.
Authorization for the Executive Director to Accept Deeds (CDC)
Recommended Action:
Adopt Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2007- , authorizing the Executive Director to accept, for recordation, deeds or grants conveying any interest in or easement upon real property to the Commission for public purposes.
C9.
Re-approval of Policy 700-07, Investment of City Funds (CC)
Recommended Action:
Re-approve the policy.
C10.
Application for an Alcohol Beverage Control (ABC) License for Rancho Vista Car Wash, 600 Hacienda Drive (CC)
Recommended Action:
Protest the application on conditions and authorize the Assistant City Manager to withdraw the protest once the applicant agrees to the recommended conditions.
C11.
2007/08 Asphalt Rehabilitation Project Change Order No. 1 (CC)
Recommended Action:
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2007- , approving a change order in the amount of $600,496.06, to the construction agreement with Sim J. Harris, Inc., and authorizing the Mayor to execute the change order.
C12.
2007/08 Asphalt Rehabilitation Project Change Order No. 2 (CC)
Recommended Action:
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2007- , approving a second change order in the amount of $240,492.55, to the construction agreement with Sim J. Harris, Inc., and authorizing the Mayor to execute the change order; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2007- , amending the Capital Improvement Program budget for FY 2006-2007
C13.
Raceway Sewer Pump Station Replacement Project (CC)
Recommended Action:
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2007- , accepting the work of Zondiros Corporation on the project as complete, approving the Notice of Completion, and directing the City Clerk to record the notice with the San Diego Recorder's Office.
C14.
Brengle Terrace Park Restroom improvement Project (CC)
Recommended Action:
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2007- , approving Change Order No. 3 to the project; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2007- , accepting the work of HTA Engineering & Construction, Inc. as complete, approving the Notice of Completion, and directing the City Clerk to record the notice with the San Diego Recorder's Office.
C15.
Used Oil Block Grant Application (CC)
Recommended Action:
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2007- , authorizing submittal of grant applications, and authorizing the City Manager to sign all related documents.
C16.
No Parking Zone on S. Melrose Drive (CC)
Recommended Action:
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2007- , establishing a "No Parking" zone on the east side of S. Melrose Drive from a point 30 feet north of the driveway to 860 S. Melrose Drive to a point 50 feet southerly.
C17.
Traffic Signal Installation and Driveway Relocation Projects (CC)
Recommended Action:
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2007- , approving the design plans and specifications for construction of the N. Santa Fe Avenue/East Drive Traffic Signal Improvement Project;
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2007- , approving the design plans and specifications for construction of the E. Vista Way/Oak Drive Traffic Signal and Driveway Relocation Improvement Project; and
3.
Authorize the City Clerk to advertise for bids for both projects.
C18.
Special Event Banner Design Addition to the 2007 Calendar Year Program (CC)
Recommended Action:
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2007- , approving
a banner design to advertise community meetings for the General Plan Update that are scheduled for
August 25, 27 and 30, 2007.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM CONSENT CALENDAR FOR DISCUSSION
DISCUSSION
D1.
Funding for the Vista Girls Softball League (CC)
Recommended Action:
Receive an oral report on the results of the team's participation in the Western National Fast Pitch Championship Tournaments and authorize $6,000
to help offset their travel expenses.
D2.
Fire Station Design Services - LEED (Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design) Certification (CC)
Recommended Action:
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2007- , approving the first amendment to the agreement with Jeff Katz Architecture for two new fire stations to increase the scope of services and the compensation ceiling for said services, and authorizing the Mayor to execute the amendment.
D3.
League of California Cities Voting Delegate and Resolutions (CC)
Recommended Action:
1.
Designate one person to serve as the City's primary voting delegate and two others to serve as alternates; and
2.
Adopt positions of support on the four resolutions slated for the League's Annual Conference in September.
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies
ADJOURNMENT
